Method of Attack: Contained malicious code that attempted to read local sensitive files and exfiltrate information through a Discord webhook
Steals sensitive files from infected users’ browser and Discord application
Impacted Systems: Developer systems using the fallguys package
Browsers like Chrome, Opera, Yandex Browser, and Brave
Attack Vector: Execution of malicious code upon integration of the package
Accessing local sensitive files and exfiltrating data through a Discord webhook
